# xshield_deployment_simulation (Data Source)

The firewall rules one asset would run before and after a deployment.

This previews the effect of `xshield_policy_deployment` on a single asset without applying anything. It is the closest thing to a dry run: the rule text is what the agent would enforce.

The simulation covers a whole-asset deployment in the given mode. Per-port plans are not previewed here; use `xshield_policy_changes` to see which ports a plan would touch.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_id` (String) Asset to simulate against. One asset at a time, since the output is its rule set.

### Optional

- `direction` (String) Which direction of policy to simulate. Defaults to inbound.
- `mode` (String) The deployment mode to preview. Defaults to enforce, the state worth checking before applying.

### Read-Only

- `candidate_rules` (String) The firewall rules the asset would run after the deployment.
- `current_rules` (String) The firewall rules the asset runs today.
- `rules_changed` (Boolean) False when the deployment would leave the asset's rules exactly as they are.
